quests.name: Tithe and Offerings
quests.description: At least once a month, faithfully pay your tithing and give generous fast and other offerings. This act of obedience invites blessings, helps build the kingdom, and supports those in need.

quests.name: Temple and Vicarious Work
quests.description: Go to the temple and participate in sacred ordinances multiple times each month. Regular temple attendance strengthens your faith, brings peace, and allows you to serve your ancestors.

quests.name: Minister to Others
quests.description: Perform ministering visits or service at least once a month. Reach out with love, support, and encouragement to those assigned to you, following the Savior's example.

quests.name: Fasting
quests.description: Participate in the monthly fast by abstaining from food and drink for two consecutive meals, praying for specific needs, and donating a generous fast offering. Fasting brings spiritual strength and blessings.

quests.name: Bear Testimony
quests.description: Share your testimony of Jesus Christ and His gospel during the monthly Testimony Sacrament meeting, especially if prompted by the Holy Spirit. By bearing testimony, you strengthen your own faith, uplift others, and help build unity and spiritual strength within the congregation.

quests.name: Contact with the Bishopric
quests.description: Schedule and attend your monthly interview with the bishopric for personal guidance, regardless of your current situation. Use this opportunity to discuss your spiritual progress, set meaningful goals, seek counsel for challenges, and receive encouragement to grow in faith and service. Let this experience inspire you to strengthen your relationship with Jesus Christ, prepare for future responsibilities, and make a positive impact in your family, church, and community.
